error: Labeling generation failed after 3 requests: CHANGES REQUIRED: The `blocker_moved` predicate is wrong. It scans the grid for any door and checks the cell to the door's left (x-1) for a ball, but the ball sits in front of the door on the start side, not necessarily at x-1, and the predicate returns true for every door whose left neighbor is ball-free — including the case where no ball ever blocked that door. Per the semantics, `blocker_moved` must be true exactly when the cell in front of the door (on the start side, the cell the agent must stand on to toggle it) holds no ball (a carried ball counts), and false if the ball is dropped back there. The fix: determine the door's front cell relative to the door orientation/start-room side rather than hard-coding x-1, and ensure the predicate reflects the absence of a ball there (plus the carried-ball disjunction), so it can turn false again when the ball is dropped back onto that cell.
